title: Terminal Escape Key Functionality Blocked in PyCharm Professional
body:
**Bug Description**
If you are running Claude code in the inbuilt terminal inside Pycharm Professional 2024.3.3  (not sure about other version but would assume its the same for all jetbrains products) You can not use the "esc" to end processes early (or leave menus) as this just auto leaves the terminal back to your code screen.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux (OpenSUSE Tumbleweed)
- Terminal: xterm-256color (default inside pycharm)
- Version: 0.2.27
- Feedback ID: 5f68088b-389a-4d60-8596-4105ca226d70
author: b-burton
